title: Better then I expected
text: Better then I expected. Super easy to put together. Sturdy and looks great. Fits a good amount of shoes.

product_metadata.title: VASAGLE 3-Tier Rack, Freestanding Shoe Storage Organizer, Mesh Shelves, Space-Saving in the Entryway, Industrial, Rustic Brown + Black
features: Black and Brown: Do you always think black and brown have a hard time matching? Well, maybe not! The matte black steel frame and the rustic brown surface of this shoe organizer harmonize perfectly
Tidy Shoes, Happy Mood: Place 4-5 pairs of shoes or other objects on the stable mesh shelves that can hold up to 11 lb each and hum happily, because your hallway now looks nice and tidy

Time-Saving Assembly: No time for tidying up your messy shoes? Don’t worry! Numbered parts and clear instructions will help you finish the assembly quickly, leaving you more time to keep your shoes in perfect order

Stability Matters: Nobody wants a rack that wobbles every time you grab a pair of shoes from it; our stable shoe rack features adjustable feet for balancing on small floor irregularities and preventing scratches on the floor
What You Get: A flexible shoe rack with 2 mesh shelves and a smooth, beautiful rustic brown finish from our practical INDESTIC Collection
